name: Nao-san
source: A coffee shop owner in the Sakurazaki area. Nao-san is well-mannered and serves as a good counselor to anyone who comes by his shop. Throughout the game his last name stays a mystery. Nao-san has a daughter named [url=/c92865]Ayano[/url] from a German wife whom he divorced.
